overview.title: reliant: overview
overview.description: Metric-backed request, server-fault and duration health across deployed processes; saturation, errors and releases. Counters are unsampled; trace drilldowns may be sampled.

panels.title: Container restarts
panels.description: The highest restart count among each workload's containers; a step is a restart.

dashboards.title: reliant: workloads
dashboards.description: Per-workload customer metadata from the node agent: CPU and memory against requests and limits, restarts and the last exit reason, the image versions that ran, and Kubernetes events. Present in deployed environments only (a local forge env up has no node agent).

panels.title: CPU usage
panels.description: Average CPU cores used per container, one line per workload.

panels.title: Memory working set
panels.description: Average working-set bytes per container, one line per workload.

panels.title: CPU against its request
panels.description: The busiest container of each workload as a fraction of the CPU it requested (1 = at the request).

panels.title: CPU against its limit
panels.description: The busiest container of each workload as a fraction of its CPU limit. Near 1 the container is being throttled.

panels.title: Memory against its request
panels.description: The fullest container of each workload as a fraction of the memory it requested.

panels.title: Memory against its limit
panels.description: The fullest container of each workload as a fraction of its memory limit. Near 1 the container is about to be OOM-killed.

panels.title: Container restarts
panels.description: The highest restart count among each workload's containers; a step is a restart.

panels.title: Restarts by last exit reason
panels.description: The same restart count split by why the container last terminated (OOMKilled, Error, Completed, ...).

panels.title: CPU by image version
panels.description: CPU used per container, split by the image tag it ran (container.image.tag), so a rollout shows as one line replacing another.

panels.title: Memory by image version
panels.description: Working-set bytes per container, split by image tag: a version that leaks memory climbs above its predecessor.

panels.title: Kubernetes events by reason
panels.description: Count of Kubernetes events per reason (BackOff, Failed, Evicted, Killing, ...) over time.

panels.title: Warning events by workload
panels.description: Warning-type Kubernetes events per workload: crash loops, failed image pulls, evictions, failed scheduling.

panels.title: Container terminations
panels.description: Events that carry a container's last terminated reason.

panels.title: Kubernetes events
panels.description: Every Kubernetes event of the selected workloads, newest first.

dashboards.title: reliant: releases
dashboards.description: Request rate, error rate and latency split by service.version, so a deploy shows as one version replacing another. Deploy markers come from the release ledger. Narrow with the service.name and deployment.environment.name filters.

panels.title: Error rate by version
panels.description: Server faults (span status Error) over all requests, per version.

panels.title: Version comparison
panels.description: Requests, errors and latency per service.version over the selected range. Pick a range that spans a deploy to read old against new.

dashboards.title: reliant: frontend
dashboards.description: Browser errors, page loads, web vitals and API calls from the HyperDX browser SDK (service.name reliant-forge-demo, reliant-web). Panels follow HyperDX's Browser RUM template: a browser span carries the rum.sessionId resource attribute.

panels.title: Failed API calls
panels.description: fetch / XHR spans with an HTTP status of 400 or more.

panels.title: Issues
panels.description: Errors grouped by cause (type, message and the top in-app frames): new and regressed first, then the most frequent. A string-only console.error is not an issue.

panels.title: Sessions with errors
panels.description: Sessions that hit an error, newest first; a session that was recorded links to its replay.

panels.title: Web vitals by route
panels.description: p75 per page. LCP good at 2500 ms or less and poor above 4000 ms; INP 200 / 500 ms; CLS 0.1 / 0.25.

panels.title: JS errors by release
panels.description: The same error spans as above, one line per service.version (the build id), so a release that introduced a regression shows as its own line. Release markers are drawn from the ledger.

panels.title: API call latency (browser)
panels.description: Browser-side fetch / XHR spans; the same calls appear server-side on the service dashboards, joined by traceparent.

panels.title: Browser console and error events
panels.description: The HyperDX SDK ships console output and uncaught errors as spans (console.*, onerror, unhandledrejection), not as OTLP logs.

dashboards.title: reliant: product usage
dashboards.description: Who uses the product and what they do, from product events: active users, new against returning, weekly retention, the pages people view and the records they create, update and delete. CRUD events are emitted automatically by the generated handlers (signals.product_events = False turns them off); page_viewed comes from the browser runtime. Hosted environments only: a local forge env up has no product_events table.

panels.title: Active users
panels.description: Distinct signed-in users with any product event in the day, 7 days and 30 days before the end of the range (DAU, WAU, MAU), and stickiness: DAU over MAU.
panels.sql:
SELECT uniqExactIf(UserId, Timestamp >= {to:DateTime64(9)} - INTERVAL 1 DAY) AS dau,
       uniqExactIf(UserId, Timestamp >= {to:DateTime64(9)} - INTERVAL 7 DAY) AS wau,
       uniqExact(UserId) AS mau,
       round(dau / nullIf(mau, 0), 2) AS stickiness
FROM product_events
WHERE UserId != '' AND Timestamp >= {to:DateTime64(9)} - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND Timestamp < {to:DateTime64(9)}
  AND (empty({env_ids:Array(String)}) OR has({env_ids:Array(String)}, EnvId)) AND (empty({services:Array(String)}) OR has({services:Array(String)}, ServiceName))

panels.title: Daily active users
panels.description: Distinct signed-in users with any product event, per UTC day.
panels.sql:
SELECT toStartOfDay(Timestamp) AS day, uniqExact(UserId) AS users
FROM product_events
WHERE UserId != '' AND Timestamp >= {from:DateTime64(9)} AND Timestamp < {to:DateTime64(9)} AND (empty({env_ids:Array(String)}) OR has({env_ids:Array(String)}, EnvId)) AND (empty({services:Array(String)}) OR has({services:Array(String)}, ServiceName))
GROUP BY day ORDER BY day

panels.title: New vs returning users per day
panels.description: Each day's active users in exactly one class: new on the day of their first event, returning after it. First-seen is the first event in the 90 days before the end of the range (or since the start of a longer range), so a user idle for longer than that counts as new again on their return.
panels.sql:
SELECT a.day AS day,
       countIf(a.day = f.first_day) AS new_users,
       countIf(a.day > f.first_day) AS returning_users
FROM (
    SELECT toStartOfDay(Timestamp) AS day, UserId
    FROM product_events
    WHERE UserId != '' AND Timestamp >= {from:DateTime64(9)} AND Timestamp < {to:DateTime64(9)} AND (empty({env_ids:Array(String)}) OR has({env_ids:Array(String)}, EnvId)) AND (empty({services:Array(String)}) OR has({services:Array(String)}, ServiceName))
    GROUP BY day, UserId
) AS a
INNER JOIN (
    SELECT UserId, toStartOfDay(min(Timestamp)) AS first_day
    FROM product_events
    WHERE UserId != '' AND Timestamp >= least({from:DateTime64(9)}, {to:DateTime64(9)} - INTERVAL 90 DAY) AND Timestamp < {to:DateTime64(9)} AND (empty({env_ids:Array(String)}) OR has({env_ids:Array(String)}, EnvId)) AND (empty({services:Array(String)}) OR has({services:Array(String)}, ServiceName))
    GROUP BY UserId
) AS f ON a.UserId = f.UserId
GROUP BY day ORDER BY day

panels.title: Weekly retention by cohort
panels.description: Users grouped by the week (Monday, UTC) of their first event, over the 12 weeks before the end of the range (whatever range is selected), and the percentage active again N weeks later. A week that has not happened yet is empty. A user's first event is their first in the 90 days before the end of the range, so one idle for longer joins the cohort of their return.

panels.title: Top pages
panels.description: page_viewed events by route: views, distinct signed-in users and sessions.
panels.sql:
SELECT Props['route'] AS route, count() AS views,
       uniqExactIf(UserId, UserId != '') AS users,
       uniqExactIf(SessionId, SessionId != '') AS sessions
FROM product_events
WHERE EventName = 'page_viewed' AND Timestamp >= {from:DateTime64(9)} AND Timestamp < {to:DateTime64(9)} AND (empty({env_ids:Array(String)}) OR has({env_ids:Array(String)}, EnvId)) AND (empty({services:Array(String)}) OR has({services:Array(String)}, ServiceName))
GROUP BY route ORDER BY views DESC LIMIT 25

panels.title: Records created, updated and deleted
panels.description: The automatic CRUD product events, per entity and action, over time.
panels.sql:
SELECT toStartOfInterval(Timestamp, toIntervalSecond({step:UInt32})) AS t,
       concat(replaceRegexpOne(EventName, '_(created|updated|deleted)$', ''), ' ', extract(EventName, '(created|updated|deleted)$')) AS action,
       count() AS events
FROM product_events
WHERE match(EventName, '_(created|updated|deleted)$') AND Timestamp >= {from:DateTime64(9)} AND Timestamp < {to:DateTime64(9)} AND (empty({env_ids:Array(String)}) OR has({env_ids:Array(String)}, EnvId)) AND (empty({services:Array(String)}) OR has({services:Array(String)}, ServiceName))
GROUP BY t, action ORDER BY t

panels.title: Actions per entity
panels.description: Creates, updates and deletes per entity in the range, and the distinct users who made them.
panels.sql:
SELECT replaceRegexpOne(EventName, '_(created|updated|deleted)$', '') AS entity,
       countIf(endsWith(EventName, '_created')) AS created,
       countIf(endsWith(EventName, '_updated')) AS updated,
       countIf(endsWith(EventName, '_deleted')) AS deleted,
       uniqExactIf(UserId, UserId != '') AS users
FROM product_events
WHERE match(EventName, '_(created|updated|deleted)$') AND Timestamp >= {from:DateTime64(9)} AND Timestamp < {to:DateTime64(9)} AND (empty({env_ids:Array(String)}) OR has({env_ids:Array(String)}, EnvId)) AND (empty({services:Array(String)}) OR has({services:Array(String)}, ServiceName))
GROUP BY entity ORDER BY created + updated + deleted DESC LIMIT 50

panels.title: Most active users
panels.description: Signed-in users by product events in the range, with the days they were active and when they were last seen.
panels.sql:
SELECT UserId AS user_id, count() AS events,
       uniqExact(toDate(Timestamp)) AS active_days,
       uniqExact(EventName) AS distinct_events,
       formatDateTime(max(Timestamp), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS last_seen_utc
FROM product_events
WHERE UserId != '' AND Timestamp >= {from:DateTime64(9)} AND Timestamp < {to:DateTime64(9)} AND (empty({env_ids:Array(String)}) OR has({env_ids:Array(String)}, EnvId)) AND (empty({services:Array(String)}) OR has({services:Array(String)}, ServiceName))
GROUP BY UserId ORDER BY events DESC, user_id LIMIT 25

panels.title: Events by name
panels.description: Every product event in the range, automatic or tracked by the app, with the distinct users who did it.
panels.sql:
SELECT EventName AS event, count() AS events, uniqExactIf(UserId, UserId != '') AS users
FROM product_events
WHERE Timestamp >= {from:DateTime64(9)} AND Timestamp < {to:DateTime64(9)} AND (empty({env_ids:Array(String)}) OR has({env_ids:Array(String)}, EnvId)) AND (empty({services:Array(String)}) OR has({services:Array(String)}, ServiceName))
GROUP BY EventName ORDER BY events DESC LIMIT 100
